body.name: Two-donor three-atom pilot certification instance
body.construction: Use the same pre-period laws, constants, and weight as in \(\mathrm{def:j2s2\mbox{-}instance}\), but set \(S=3\).  In the post period let donor one put masses \(1/2+h_c/\sqrt{m_\ell}\) and \(1/2-h_c/\sqrt{m_\ell}\) at \(0\) and \(2\), donor two put masses \(1/2\) and \(1/2\) at \(0\) and \(2\), and the treated intervention law put masses \(1/2\), \(d_{0t2}/\sqrt{m_\ell}\), and \(1/2-d_{0t2}/\sqrt{m_\ell}\) at \(0,1,2\).  Define the post no-intervention quantile by the same stable weight: \(Q^N_{0,2,\ell}=w_{\ell1}Q_{1,2,\ell}+w_{\ell2}Q_{2,2,\ell}\).  Take \(0\leq h_f\leq\sqrt{n_\ell}\), \(0\leq h_c\leq\sqrt{m_\ell}/2\), \(0\leq d_{0t2}\leq\sqrt{m_\ell}/2\), and \(0<\lambda\leq1/375\), with independent cell samples as in \(\mathrm{def:j2s2\mbox{-}instance}\).  These clauses define the two-donor, three-atom local experiment \(\mathfrak E_{2,3}(h_f,h_c,d_{0t2})\).
